# shares content

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sharesContent`](gmeow-sharesContent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sharesContent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

Relates a posting to content it shares or reposts — another posting, an article, a media object. The repost/share/boost edge. Non-functional. Projects to [schema:sharedContent.](https://schema.org/sharedContent.)
